inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn Japanese 2D anime frame. Keep clean dark ink contours, flat matte skin, hard-edged two-tone cel shadows, broad drawn hair locks and painted blue gothic cathedral scenery in EVERY frame. Preserve the exact character identities, clothing, scale, architecture, colors, camera angle and composition. No 3D rendering, glossy plastic, realistic skin, dimensional fur, cuts, camera orbit, extra limbs, text, subtitles or new characters. A restrained dramatic anime shot, not a looping illustration. Rear view of the same black-and-gold robed priest, walking AWAY from the camera UP the central altar steps. He takes three deliberate natural steps, placing a foot on each higher tread before raising his weight. His shoulders rise with each step; the heavy robe hem follows the ankles with a small delay and never floats through the stone. The torch stays in his right hand, its violet flame flickers gently. Preserve the altar destination, fixed stair axis, the blue windows and the symmetrical braziers. No backward steps, sliding, leg crossing, robe stretching or camera movement. End farther up the stairs, still facing away.
